Name: Twitch Chat Integration
Author: Hexenentendrache
Description:
This mod pushes Twitch chat messages of a specified channel into the ingame chat. For somewhat better readability each message sender is assigned one color, though the same can be used for multiple people.

If used in multiplayer, the messages will only be visible to the user of the mod, not the other players.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI once, then close it again.
[*]Edit the newly created [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] (or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).
[*]Re-run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
You will need to provide a Twitch account that the chat bot can use, you can use the one you use to stream or a separate one. For this, follow these steps:
[list=1]
[*]Create a "Bot Chat Token" on the website [url=https://twitchtokengenerator.com/]https://twitchtokengenerator.com/[/url] by choosing the "Bot Chat Token" option.
[*]Go through the login process and fill out the Captcha.
[*]In the [font=Courier New]Generated Tokens[/font] section, copy the [font=Courier New]ACCESS TOKEN[/font] value.
[*]If not using GMCM, run the game once to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file. Once the file is made, open it in a text editor and fill out the [font=Courier New]Username[/font] and [font=Courier New]Password[/font] sections (for the latter, use the [font=Courier New]ACCESS TOKEN[/font] you generated in the last steps).
[*]Make sure to fill out the [font=Courier New]TargetChannel[/font] section with the name of the channel you want to inspect (usually your own channel).
[/list][list]
[/list]Other optional fields in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] that may be interesting:[list]
[*]"IgnoredAccounts": here you can list names of accounts whose messages you do not want to be sent into the in-game chat, for example your bots
[*]"IgnoreCommands": if this is set to true, then messages that start with "!" will be ignored, since that is a common command prefix
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer (splitscreen not tested yet).
[/list]
